headline: Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals Following $40 Million Security Breach
summary: Brazilian cryptocurrency exchange Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits and withdrawals after hackers drained approximately $40 million across 10 blockchains.
why: Cryptocurrency exchanges act as vital liquidity venues and custodians for digital assets, and severe security breaches disrupt market confidence and client operations.

impacts.name: Mercado Bitcoin
impacts.why: The company halted withdrawals following a $40 million security breach affecting its wallets.
